caption_L1: This bar graph is titled Reported and apparent cobalt consumption in the United States from 2010 to 2019 (in metric tons). The x-axis shows Apparent (includes secondary) while the y-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: In 2010 the cobalt consumption in the US was around 10,000 metric tonnes. Although dropping very slightly to just over 8000 tonnes in the next 5 years it remained fairly steady before leaping to over 11000 in 2016. It then dropped to under 8000 in 2018 and then jumped up dramatically to over 12000 in 2019.
